name: Seyi Vibez
description:
'''Balogun Afolabi Oluwaloseyi''' (born 12 July 2000), known professionally as '''Seyi Vibez''', is a Nigerian singer and songwriter. He rose to prominence in 2023 with the single "Chance (Na Ham)", which debuted at No. 19 on the [[UK Afrobeats Singles Chart|UK Afrobeats singles chart]] and peaked number 7 on the [[TurnTable Top 100|TurnTable Top 100 chart]]. 

Known for his prolific output, Seyi Vibez released the number-one albums ''[[Billion Dollar Baby (album)|Billion Dollar Baby]]'' (2022) and ''Swaguu'' (2026), the latter of which was executive-produced by [[Burna Boy]].
